explication: Laravel is a PHP web application framework. Its principal application workflow accepts an HTTP request, routes it through middleware and application services, and returns a response; the framework also provides persistence, background processing, and real-time broadcasting capabilities. The tree and excerpts support several internal links, while many product subsystems are represented only by their directories and README description. Those relationships are therefore omitted or marked unverified rather than inferred from names alone.
